entities.name: PTC7 phosphatase homolog
observations: The 312-aa query is an exact full-sequence match to reviewed Drosophila mojavensis UniProt B4K616, annotated as protein phosphatase PTC7 homolog.
The reference annotates protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity (GO:0004722; inferred from homology), mitochondrial localization (GO:0005739), EC 3.1.3.16, and Mg2+/Mn2+ cofactors.
PP2C_2 and SpoIIE family profiles occur across query residues 64–268; exact protein substrates and biological-process role are not identified by these data.
